# WordPress.org
> Open source software you can use to create a website, blog, or application.

WordPress.org is the official home of the WordPress open-source publishing platform and CMS. It provides core software downloads, documentation, developer references, themes, plugins, community resources, and contributor tools for building and extending WordPress.

## Core WordPress
- [Download WordPress](https://wordpress.org/download/): Download the latest WordPress release with requirements, checksums, and installation guidance.
- [Release Archive](https://wordpress.org/download/releases/): Browse current and historical WordPress core releases and package downloads.
- [About WordPress](https://wordpress.org/about/): Learn about WordPress, its history, freedoms, and open-source project mission.
- [Features](https://wordpress.org/about/features/): Overview of core publishing, customization, media, and site management capabilities.
- [Requirements](https://wordpress.org/about/requirements/): Server software and version requirements for running WordPress.
- [Roadmap](https://wordpress.org/about/roadmap/): Summary of major WordPress version milestones and project direction.
- [Stats](https://wordpress.org/about/stats/): Usage statistics showing WordPress adoption across the web.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://wordpress.org/documentation/): Central hub for end-user documentation, setup guides, and site management help.
- [Getting Started](https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/get-started-with-wordpress/): Introductory guide for learning WordPress basics and first steps.
- [Installing WordPress](https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/how-to-install-wordpress/): Step-by-step instructions for installing WordPress on a server.
- [Update WordPress](https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/updating-wordpress/): Guidance for safely updating WordPress core to newer versions.
- [Security](https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/hardening-wordpress/): Recommended practices for securing and hardening WordPress installations.
- [Basic Troubleshooting](https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/faq-troubleshooting/): Common troubleshooting steps for diagnosing WordPress issues.
- [Advanced Administration Handbook](https://wordpress.org/documentation/advanced-administration/): In-depth administration topics for configuration, performance, and maintenance.

## Developer Resources
- [Developer Resources Home](https://developer.wordpress.org/): Portal for WordPress code reference, handbooks, APIs, and developer guides.
- [Code Reference](https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/): Reference documentation for WordPress functions, classes, hooks, and methods.
- [Block Editor Handbook](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/): Guides and APIs for building blocks and extending the editor.
- [Theme Handbook](https://developer.wordpress.org/themes/): Best practices and technical guidance for developing WordPress themes.
- [Plugin Handbook](https://developer.wordpress.org/plugins/): Documentation for building, structuring, and maintaining WordPress plugins.
- [REST API Handbook](https://developer.wordpress.org/rest-api/): Reference and guides for using and extending the WordPress REST API.
- [CLI Handbook](https://developer.wordpress.org/cli/commands/): Command reference and usage guides for WP-CLI.
- [Coding Standards](https://developer.wordpress.org/coding-standards/): Official coding standards for PHP, JavaScript, CSS, and accessibility.

## Themes, Plugins, and Patterns
- [Plugin Directory](https://wordpress.org/plugins/): Official repository of free WordPress plugins for extending site functionality.
- [Theme Directory](https://wordpress.org/themes/): Official repository of free WordPress themes for site design and layout.
- [Pattern Directory](https://wordpress.org/patterns/): Reusable block patterns for page sections, layouts, and content compositions.
- [Browse Plugins by Category](https://wordpress.org/plugins/browse/): Explore plugins by featured, popular, beta, and recommended categories.
- [Browse Themes by Feature](https://wordpress.org/themes/browse/): Explore themes by layout, subject, and feature filters.
- [Create a Block Theme](https://developer.wordpress.org/themes/core-concepts/): Learn the core concepts behind modern block theme development.

## APIs and Extensibility
- [REST API Reference](https://developer.wordpress.org/rest-api/reference/): Endpoint reference for posts, users, media, taxonomies, and more.
- [Block API](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/): Technical reference for registering and configuring editor blocks.
- [Interactivity API](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/interactivity-api/): Build interactive front-end experiences using WordPress block tooling.
- [Settings API](https://developer.wordpress.org/plugins/settings/settings-api/): Register, display, and manage plugin settings in WordPress admin.
- [Options API](https://developer.wordpress.org/plugins/settings/options-api/): Store and retrieve persistent plugin and theme configuration values.
- [Shortcode API](https://developer.wordpress.org/plugins/shortcodes/): Add user-facing shortcode tags and handlers to WordPress content.
- [Rewrite API](https://developer.wordpress.org/plugins/hooks/custom-queries-and-routing/): Customize URL routing and request handling in WordPress.

## Hosting and Playground
- [Hosting](https://wordpress.org/hosting/): Information about WordPress hosting and recommended hosting providers.
- [Hosting Handbook](https://make.wordpress.org/hosting/handbook/): Contributor handbook for the WordPress hosting team and ecosystem standards.
- [WordPress Playground](https://wordpress.org/playground/): Run WordPress instantly in the browser without local setup or hosting.
- [Playground Documentation](https://developer.wordpress.org/playground/): Developer documentation for using and embedding WordPress Playground.
- [Try WordPress](https://wordpress.org/playground/): Launch a temporary browser-based WordPress instance for testing and learning.

## Community and Contribution
- [Make WordPress](https://make.wordpress.org/): Contributor hub for WordPress teams, blogs, handbooks, and project collaboration.
- [Core Team](https://make.wordpress.org/core/): Development updates, proposals, and contributor resources for WordPress core.
- [Themes Team](https://make.wordpress.org/themes/): Guidelines and processes for reviewing and maintaining themes.
- [Plugins Team](https://make.wordpress.org/plugins/): Policies and updates for plugin authors and directory contributors.
- [Polyglots Team](https://make.wordpress.org/polyglots/): Translation team resources for localizing WordPress and extensions.
- [Community Team](https://make.wordpress.org/community/): Resources for WordPress events, meetups, and community organizers.
- [Five for the Future](https://wordpress.org/five-for-the-future/): Initiative encouraging organizations to contribute time to WordPress.
- [Contribute to WordPress](https://wordpress.org/contribute/): Overview of ways to participate in the WordPress project.

## Support and Forums
- [Support Home](https://wordpress.org/support/): Entry point for WordPress support forums and help resources.
- [Documentation in Support](https://wordpress.org/support/docs/): Support-oriented documentation for common WordPress tasks and issues.
- [Fixing WordPress](https://wordpress.org/support/article/faq-troubleshooting/): Troubleshooting article covering common errors and recovery steps.
- [Plugin Support Forums](https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/): Support forum index for plugins in the official directory.
- [Theme Support Forums](https://wordpress.org/support/theme/): Support forum index for themes in the official directory.
- [Requests and Feedback](https://wordpress.org/support/forum/requests-and-feedback/): Community forum for WordPress.org site feedback and suggestions.

## News and Releases
- [WordPress News](https://wordpress.org/news/): Official news, release announcements, and project updates from WordPress.
- [Latest Releases](https://wordpress.org/download/releases/): Release archive for stable and historical WordPress versions.
- [Security Releases](https://wordpress.org/news/category/security/): Posts announcing WordPress security releases and related updates.
- [Development Blog](https://make.wordpress.org/core/): Ongoing development notes, proposals, and release planning discussions.
- [Release Candidate Announcements](https://wordpress.org/news/category/releases/): Official posts for beta, release candidate, and major version launches.

## Showcase and Ecosystem
- [Showcase](https://wordpress.org/showcase/): Examples of notable websites built with WordPress across industries.
- [Openverse](https://wordpress.org/openverse/): Search engine for openly licensed images and audio from the WordPress project.
- [Photo Directory](https://wordpress.org/photos/): Community-curated directory of openly licensed photographs.
- [Learn WordPress](https://learn.wordpress.org/): Educational workshops, tutorials, and lesson plans for WordPress users.
- [WordCamp Central](https://central.wordcamp.org/): Information about official WordPress conferences and community events.
